name: Anchored Coffee House
description: Anchored Coffee House is a welcoming cafe offering locally roasted coffee blends paired with delicious pastries and light fare. Located in Gulf Shores AL, we provide a warm environment where friends gather over cappuccinos or croissants. Our complimentary conference room is perfect for small meetings while soothing Christian tunes set a peaceful tone. Every sip tells our story of community connection and quality craftsmanship.
